notablePrerequisites: Lightning Greaves is attached to Jegantha.
description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha, causing target player to mill five cards.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Jegantha.
Repeat.
